visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man wearing a black sleeveless tank top, a black backward cap, and a black fitness watch performs heavy squats at a power rack. The gym setting features bright overhead studio lighting and numerous colorful weight plates arranged on storage racks in the background. (2) A close-up shot transitions to the man smiling warmly toward the camera. He is now wearing a black t-shirt with a brand logo and small silver earrings; the background shows rows of black dumbbells and gym patrons in the distance. (3) The man is shown lying flat on a gray rubber gym floor, his body limp and eyes closed as if unconscious. White variety-show text is positioned near his shoulder, while the gym's fluorescent lights reflect off the floor surface. (4) From a first-person perspective, two other men are seen leaning over the unconscious man, looking down with concerned expressions. One man wears glasses and a yellow cap, and the lighting is high-contrast, originating from the gym's ceiling fixtures above. (5) The man is suddenly seen holding massive stacks of blue 1000-dollar bills, laughing hysterically at the camera. He is in a bright outdoor coastal setting with palm trees and a harbor visible through large glass windows in the background. (6) Wearing a green floral patterned shirt and dark sunglasses, the man is now surrounded by four women in bikinis and summer clothes inside a cabin. Stacks of cash are scattered all over his lap and the seat while everyone cheers and waves. (7) The scene shifts back to the gym floor where a staff member's hand enters the frame to wake the man up. He looks dazed and confused, lying next to a row of heavy professional dumbbells under bright indoor lighting. (8) A highly colorful digital poster fills the screen, advertising the 'STEP C WAVE PARTY' with photos of various performers and DJs. The graphic background features purple and teal wavy patterns with a cruise ship illustration. (9) A montage displays the man and the swimsuit-clad women on the boat again, laughing and holding money. Vibrant variety-style text overlays appear in the center, highlighting specific dates and the name of the upcoming cruise party. (10) A final informational screen appears with a black background and white/yellow text detailing the ticket booking process. It includes the event logo, the KLOOK platform name, and the dates of the event set for September 2025.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator, 3 other men in the gym scenes, and 5 women in the boat scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A muscular man with a shaved head, often seen in gym attire (tank top) or a floral party shirt and sunglasses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern well-equipped gym with weight racks and dumbbells; a cruise ship interior with large windows looking out at palm trees and water.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The sound opens with heavy rhythmic breathing and physical strain, followed by a loud percussive 'thud' indicating a heavy fall on a rubber floor. (2) A male voice enters with high urgency and concern, asking 'Xian sheng, xian sheng, hei, ni hai hao ma?' while heavy breathing continues in the background. (3) Several male voices begin whispering in a conspiratorial, low-pitch tone, discussing the possibility of the person being dead and the financial repercussions. A low, ominous synth pad hums in the background. (4) A sharp transition occurs as a high-pitched, extremely excited male voice shouts 'Wa! Mei xiang dao hui pei zhe me duo qian!' followed by energetic, fast-tempo electronic dance music with a heavy beat. (5) Sounds of multiple people laughing and cheering loudly overlap with the high-energy music, creating a high-arousal party atmosphere. (6) An abrupt 'record scratch' sound effect cuts the music completely, replaced by a calm, level-toned male voice stating 'Xian sheng bu hao yi si, da yang luo' in a quiet room setting. (7) Upbeat and professional pop-style background music resumes as the main male speaker delivers a fast-paced, enthusiastic promotional announcement regarding dates and ticket booking on KLOOK.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Comedic Skit Setup -> Dream Sequence Twist -> Reality Check -> Event Promotion Call-to-Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a comedic 'dream' sequence, where the creator imagines spending a massive settlement from a gym injury on a luxury cruise party, to grab attention before pivoting to a real endorsement for the 'STEP C WAVE PARTY' cruise event.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a full poster and final screen dedicated to the event, with specific instructions to search for it on KLOOK.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The creator uses his established persona (Peeta Gege) to create a viral-style skit that blends fitness humor with event marketing.
